card.statement:
Define an ordering $\preceq$ on $\Lambda^{-}$ by:

- $(-k,0,...,0) \prec (0,...,0)$ if $k > 0;$ $(-k,0,...,0) \prec (-m,0,...,0)$ with $k,m > 0$ if $k < m.$

For $r > 1,$

- $(k_{1},...k_{r-1},-k,0,...,0) \prec (m_{1},...,m_{r-1},0,...,0)$ if $k > 0.$

- $(k_{1},...,k_{r-1}, -k,0,...,0) \prec (m_{1},...,m_{r-1},-m,0,...,0)$ with $k,m > 0$ if either $k < m $ or $k = m$ and $(k_{1},..., k_{r-1},0,...,0) < (m_{1},..., m_{r-1},0,...,0)$ in the previous ordering.

Define an ordering on the basis $ \{ w_{a}, u_{a} , a\in \Lambda ^{-} \}$ of $\mathfrak t^{-}$ putting $w_{a} < u_{a}$ for $a\in \Lambda^{-}$
and $z_{a} < z_{b}$ if $a \prec b$ , where $z_{a} \in \{ u_{a}, w_{a} \}, z_{b} \in \{u_{b}, w_{b} \}.$

The monomials

$$z_{a_{1}}...z_{a_{s}}v_{\lambda}$$

with $a_{i} \in \Lambda^{-},$ and $z_{a_{1}}\leq z_{ a_{2}}\leq ... \leq z_{a_{s}}$ form a basis of $H(\lambda)$.
card.label: Lemma 1

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules for the extended affine Lie algebra $sl_{2}(\mathbb C_{q})$
paper.abstract: We consider one of the most natural extended affine Lie lagebras, the algebra $sl_2({\mathbb C}_q)$ and begin a theory of its representations. In particular, we study a class of imaginary Verma modules, obtain a criterion of irreducibility and describe their submodule structure in "general position".
